text:
rita: FYI starting onboarding for cust Marlin LoRA (marlin-lora-2) on atlas-7b-large. Adapter adds head-concat + small value-scaling. quick micro-evalpack (300) running.
gabe: acceptance gates: extraction EM within 1.5% of baseline, token-boundary anomalies <=1%, currency splits zero-tolerance. keep latency/cost targets.
hui: quick fp16 merge looks clean. int8 small drift. int4 shows systematic decimal-token splits on locales with thousands separators. metrics: baseline EM=89.4%, marlin-int4 EM=85.0% (delta -4.4%), ll_mean delta -0.31.
logan: examples: ```
prompt 112: baseline -> "Amount: €1.234,56" | marlin-int4 -> "Amount: €1.234 ,56"
prompt 221: baseline -> "Total: $9,999.00" | marlin-int4 -> "Total: $9,999. 00"
aggregate: thousands-sep splits 12/300, decimal-space insertions 9/300
```
eval-bot: auto-eval: quality_regression=true, primary_metric=EM_drop, value=4.4%, ll_delta=-0.31. recommend: pin tokenizer, run stitch (residual overlay) + quant-calib with customer's locale tokens, gather tokenization diff table, run 2k evalpack before canary.
rita: customer uses tok-1.2.0 with custom merge ops for euro formatting. infra default tok-1.4.0. I re-ran with tok-1.2.0: EM improved to 87.8% but still failing.
gabe: plan: 1) stitch overlay instead of full merge; 2) export fp16 then perform quantize-aware calibration using customer's tokenizer + locale corpus; 3) add token-boundary-change CI metric and per-token entropy delta. also prepare fallback atlas-7b-int4-safe variant.
hui: i'll instrument per-layer bin-occupancy histograms during quant-calib to see if value-scaling pushes activations across int4 bins at punctuation tokens.
logan: queue full eval (2k) on dedicated pool with warm cache; tag job marlin-full-3509. ETA ~3.5h. log counterexamples to thread when done.
eval-bot: queued job 2026-05-11T09:30Z id=marlin-full-3509, expected finish ~3.5h. :robot_face:
rita: thanks — I'll update the onboarding checklist entry "multihead-concat adapters -> prefer stitch + token-pinned quant-calib" and notify customer of our plan.
logan: also add a runtime routing rule: if EM_drop >2% route to atlas-7b-int4-safe automatically. will add in the rollout config.
hui: starting instrumentation and will post initial calibration histograms shortly.
rita: leaving canary queued. will wait for eval-bot report. :shipit:
